title: Opaque identifiers
description: Identifiers propagate into logs, traces, metric labels and vendor dashboards, so they are opaque by construction and never carry a name, email or phone number. The control plane generates them and rejects consumer-supplied ones.

SecretRef.description: A reference into the secrets store, never a value. Config documents are safe to store, diff, log and hand to a consumer.

Channel.description: Transport channel. Turn constants, codecs and attribution strategy all vary by it.

Role.description: Token grants derive from the role and never from a client request; room-admin grants are never issued to a client. This is the role vocabulary only. Role as a config overlay axis is a separate, later piece of work.
